EC1: Females who are pregnant [OR] or nursing.
EC2: Patients [NOT] not scheduled for trans-jugular liver biopsy
EC3: Patients who have received an investigational drug in the 30 days before study drug administration, or will receive one within 72 h afterwards,.
EC4: Patients with known [OR] or suspected right-to-left [OR], bi-directional [OR], or transient right-to-left cardiac shunts
EC5: Patients with pulmonary hypertension [OR] or unstable cardiopulmonary conditions
EC6: Patients currently on chemotherapy [OR] or with other primary cancers requiring systemic [OR] or hepatic loco-regional treatment.
EC7: Patients who are medically unstable [OR], patients who are seriously [OR] or terminally ill [OR], and patients whose clinical course is unpredictable. For example:
EC8: Patients on life support [AND] or in a critical care unit.
EC9: Patients with unstable occlusive disease (e.g., crescendo angina)
EC10: Patients with clinically unstable cardiac arrhythmias [AND], such as recurrent ventricular tachycardia.
EC11: Patients with uncontrolled congestive heart failure (NYHA Class IV)
EC13: Patients who have undergone surgery within 24 hours prior to the study sonographic examination [AND].
EC14: Patients with a history of anaphylactic allergy to eggs [OR] or egg products, manifested by one or more of the following symptoms: generalized urticaria [OR], difficulty in breathing [OR], swelling of the [OR] mouth [OR] and throat, hypotension [OR], or shock. (Subjects with nonanaphylactic allergies to eggs or egg products may be enrolled in the study, but must be watched carefully for 1 h following the administration of SONAZOID).
EC16: Patients with severe emphysema [OR], pulmonary vasculitis [OR], or a history of pulmonary emboli.
EC18: Patients with thrombosis within the hepatic [OR], portal [OR], or mesenteric veins.
